text:
Maya: Quick check — need to replay one failing prod request to debug model alignment. Can we capture the full request body to a secure S3 bucket for 48h? I'll scrub tokens but want permission on access scope.
Jamal: What's the minimum we need? full body or just prompt + metadata?
Maya: Ideally full body for the replay, because we need headers to reproduce routing. Plan: redact `Authorization`, HMAC the `user_id`, and mask emails to `*@example.com`. Keep prompt text but run through the prompt-scrubber.
Sam: FYI this touches compliance. We should pseudonymize rather than redact for traceability — HMAC + salt from KMS. Who will have access?
Maya: Access would be limited to me, Sam, and EngOncall for 48h. We'll attach a ticket and an access justification. No downloads allowed.
Jamal: Sounds ok if audit trail + short TTL. Add `x-request-id` & `trace-id` columns to the log so we can revoke.
security-bot: NOTE: Remember to open an access request in the access-portal and add the data-retention tag. Auto-audit will run.
Maya: Will do. Proposed scrub rules (pseudo):
```
redact_fields: ["Authorization", "api_key"]
hash_fields: [{"name":"user_id","method":"hmac-sha256","kms_key":"projects/redwood/keys/req-hmac"}]
mask_patterns: [{"field":"email","pattern":"(?<=.).(?=[^@]+@)","replace":"*"}]
retention_ttl: 48h
allowed_viewers: ["maya","sam","eng-oncall"]
```
Sam: One request — please use per-request salt derived from `x-request-id` so identical user_ids across requests don't correlate. Also log the salt in the audit record (not the raw user_id).
Maya: Good call. I'll switch to `HMAC(user_id, KMS_SIGN(x-request-id))`.
Jamal: Also add a quick grep blacklist to ensure we don't accidentally store raw `token=` substrings in any free-text fields.
Maya: Will add a filter: `if /token=\w{8,}/ then drop-field`.
security-bot: Checklist: access request + ticket #, data-retention tag, KMS key ARN, auditors cc'd.
audit-bot: Created ticket AIS-2043 for replay access request by Maya. Audit trail will attach when S3 object written.
Sam: From Security side — I'm fine with temporary capture under those rules. I'll sign off once AIS-2043 has conservative ACLs and lifecycle set.
Maya: Thanks — I'll open AIS-2043 now and post the ticket link here. If anyone objects, speak up within 2h. :+1:
